headline: As of 2026-09-24: 165,128 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 10 of 50 states, D+47.9 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 165,128 early/mail ballots cast so far across 10 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+47.9 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (117,602), Wisconsin (21,149), Pennsylvania (13,806).
